newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Costa Rican lawyer killed in Nigerian plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rican lawyer killed in Nigerian plane crash.

text.p: A prominent Costa Rican lawyer, Joacquin Tascan, was one of the 141 people killed in a Nigerian plane crash, aviation authorities said on Saturday.
"Dr J. Tacsan was on board and his name is on the manifest," a spokesman for the Federal Airport Authority of Nigeria told Reuters.

The authorities are yet to release the list of passengers on the Boeing 727 plane which disappeared on Thursday and was found next day in a lagoon in village 40 km (25 miles) from Lagos. All 132 passengers and nine crew were killed.
Tacsan was the right-hand man of Nobel Peace Prize winner Oscar Arias and was well known in the Caribbean and Latin America for his mediation efforts in various regional crises.
He is among many foreigners including British, American, Italian, German and Indians killed in the crash.
Villagers were recovering the remains of the victims from the lagoon on Saturday.
